question: Should OpenClaw add explicit read-only recursive/depth mode to the existing `subagents` tool and `/subagents list`, or wait for a broader session-chain/tree API?
rationale: The missing source behavior is clear, but this changes public model-facing and slash-command semantics and must align with current direct-control boundaries plus adjacent hierarchy observability work.

options.title: Add Read-Only Depth Listing
options.body: Add explicit `depth`/`recursive` listing with flattened descendant rows and parent/depth metadata while keeping mutation targets direct-scoped by default.

options.title: Fold Into Chain/Tree Work
options.body: Keep this request blocked on the broader hierarchy APIs in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/11040 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54578 to avoid parallel surfaces.

options.title: Decline Recursive Core Listing
options.body: Document direct-child visibility plus descendant counts as intentional and leave deeper monitoring to status files or future plugin/UI surfaces.

recommendation.title: Add Read-Only Depth Listing
recommendation.body: Add explicit `depth`/`recursive` listing with flattened descendant rows and parent/depth metadata while keeping mutation targets direct-scoped by default.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the nested subagent and `subagents` tool surface that this product/API decision would extend.
